title: 3.1.B3 Build-Up — Rotate on Multiple Axes
description: Add X and Z rotation with different speed multipliers so the Spinning Sculpture tumbles in 3D.

steps.title: Add X and Z rotation
steps.instructions: In draw(), add two more rotation lines: `bigCube.rotation.x = radians(frameCount * 0.7)` and `bigCube.rotation.z = radians(frameCount * 0.3)`. Use different multipliers so each axis spins at a different speed.
hints: Slower multipliers on X and Z create an irregular tumbling motion that looks more interesting than a simple spin.
